records.question: Count the number of pilots with age greater than 40.
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM pilotskills WHERE age  >  40

records.question: How many planes are controlled by the pilots whose age is older than 40?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(plane_name) FROM pilotskills WHERE age  >  40

records.question: What are the names of pilots who own both Piper Cub and the B-52 Bomber?
records.gold_sql: SELECT pilot_name FROM pilotskills WHERE plane_name  =  'Piper Cub' INTERSECT SELECT pilot_name FROM pilotskills WHERE plane_name  =  'B-52 Bomber'

records.question: What are the names of pilots who have planes in both Austin and Boston?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.pilot_name FROM pilotskills AS T1 JOIN hangar AS T2 ON T1.plane_name  =  T2.plane_name WHERE T2.location  =  "Austin" INTERSECT SELECT T1.pilot_name FROM pilotskills AS T1 JOIN hangar AS T2 ON T1.plane_name  =  T2.plane_name WHERE T2.LOCATION  =  "Boston"

records.question: Return the average age of pilots for each plane name.
records.gold_sql: SELECT avg(age) ,  plane_name FROM pilotskills GROUP BY plane_name

records.question: Select the warehouse code and the average value of the boxes in each warehouse.
records.gold_sql: SELECT warehouse ,  avg(value) FROM boxes GROUP BY warehouse

records.question: Select all distinct contents in all the boxes.
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT CONTENTS FROM boxes

records.question: List the code and contents of all boxes sorted by their values.
records.gold_sql: SELECT code ,  CONTENTS FROM boxes ORDER BY value

records.question: List all different types of contents ordered by contents.
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT CONTENTS FROM boxes ORDER BY CONTENTS

records.question: What are the codes and corresponding contents of boxes for which their value is higher than the values of all boxes containing Scissors?
records.gold_sql: SELECT code ,  CONTENTS FROM boxes WHERE value  >  (SELECT max(value) FROM boxes WHERE CONTENTS  =  'Scissors')

records.question: List the titles of books in ascending alphabetical order.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Title FROM book ORDER BY Title ASC

records.question: What are the maximum and minimum number of chapters for each book?
records.gold_sql: SELECT max(Chapters) ,  min(Chapters) FROM book

records.question: What are the titles and ratings of books?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Title ,  T2.Rating FROM book AS T1 JOIN review AS T2 ON T1.Book_ID  =  T2.Book_ID

records.question: What is the average number of readers for books of type "Novel"?
records.gold_sql: SELECT avg(T2.Readers_in_Million) FROM book AS T1 JOIN review AS T2 ON T1.Book_ID  =  T2.Book_ID WHERE T1.Type  =  "Novel"

records.question: List the titles of books in ascending order of the ratings in review?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Title FROM book AS T1 JOIN review AS T2 ON T1.Book_ID  =  T2.Book_ID ORDER BY T2.Rating ASC

records.question: List the winning drivers and winning teams of races in ascending alphabetical order of winning team.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Winning_driver ,  Winning_team FROM race ORDER BY Winning_team ASC

records.question: Return the different constructors of drivers, ordered by age ascending.
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT CONSTRUCTOR FROM driver ORDER BY Age ASC

records.question: Please show the age of the driver who participated in the most number of races.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Age FROM driver AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.Driver_ID  =  T2.Driver_ID GROUP BY T1.Driver_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the age of the driver who raced in the most races?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.Age FROM driver AS T1 JOIN race AS T2 ON T1.Driver_ID  =  T2.Driver_ID GROUP BY T1.Driver_ID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: List the types of engines that are used by at least two drivers.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Engine FROM driver GROUP BY Engine HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  2

records.question: What are the different names of sailors who reserved two or more boats ?
records.gold_sql: select distinct t1.name ,  t1.sid from sailors as t1 join reserves as t2 on t1.sid  =  t2.sid group by t2.sid having count(*)  >=  2

records.question: Find the id of Sailors (sid) that reserved red and blue boat.
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T2.sid FROM Boats AS T1 JOIN Reserves AS T2 ON  T1.bid  =  T2.bid WHERE T1.color  =  'red' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT T2.sid FROM Boats AS T1 JOIN Reserves AS T2 ON  T1.bid  =  T2.bid WHERE T1.color  =  "blue"

records.question: What is the name of all sailors whose rating is higher than any sailor named Luis?
records.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM Sailors WHERE rating  >  (SELECT min(rating) FROM Sailors WHERE name  =  'Luis')

records.question: What are the names of the sailors whose rating is larger than the rating of all sailors who booked a red boat?
records.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM Sailors WHERE rating  >  (SELECT max(T1.rating) FROM Sailors AS T1 JOIN Reserves AS T2 ON T1.sid  =  T2.sid JOIN Boats AS T3 ON T3.bid  =  T2.bid WHERE T3.color  =  'red')

records.question: What is the maximum rating for sailors?
records.gold_sql: SELECT max(rating) FROM Sailors

records.question: What is the average justice scores among countries?
records.gold_sql: SELECT avg(justice_score) FROM countries

records.question: What are the maximum and minimum health scores among countries that are not "Norway".
records.gold_sql: SELECT max(health_score) ,  min(health_score) FROM countries WHERE name != "Norway"

records.question: What is the name of the country with the highest politics score?
records.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM countries ORDER BY politics_score DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the official language that is most common?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM official_languages AS T1 JOIN languages AS T2 ON T1.language_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What are the names of the three official languages spoken in the most countries?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM official_languages AS T1 JOIN languages AS T2 ON T1.language_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: Find the nationality and card credit of each customer.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Nationality ,  Card_Credit FROM customer

records.question: Show the names of customers with nationality "England" or "Australia".
records.gold_sql: SELECT Name FROM customer WHERE Nationality  =  "England" OR Nationality  =  "Australia"

records.question: How many customers are associated with each nationality? List the nationality and the number of customers.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Nationality ,  COUNT(*) FROM customer GROUP BY Nationality

records.question: Show the nations that have both customers with card credit smaller than 50 and customers with card credit bigger than 75.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Nationality FROM customer WHERE Card_Credit  <  50 INTERSECT SELECT Nationality FROM customer WHERE Card_Credit  >  75

records.question: Show distinct managers of branches.
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT Manager FROM branch

records.question: What is the id of the driver who has driven the most vehicles, and how many vehicles is this?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  driver_id FROM vehicle_driver GROUP BY driver_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Return the top speed and power of the vehicle that was built in the year 1996.
records.gold_sql: SELECT top_speed ,  power FROM vehicle WHERE build_year  =  1996

records.question: What are the models which have not been driven by any drivers?
records.gold_sql: SELECT model FROM vehicle EXCEPT SELECT T1.model FROM vehicle AS T1 JOIN vehicle_driver AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_id  =  T2.vehicle_id

records.question: Return the models of vehicles that have never been driven.
records.gold_sql: SELECT model FROM vehicle EXCEPT SELECT T1.model FROM vehicle AS T1 JOIN vehicle_driver AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_id  =  T2.vehicle_id

records.question: Return the ids and models of vehicles that have been driven by exactly two drivers or built by Ziyang.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.vehicle_id ,  T1.model FROM vehicle AS T1 JOIN vehicle_driver AS T2 ON T1.vehicle_id  =  T2.vehicle_id GROUP BY T2.vehicle_id HAVING count(*)  =  2 OR T1.builder  =  'Ziyang'

records.question: What is the total population of the districts whose areas are in the top 3?
records.gold_sql: SELECT sum(population) FROM district ORDER BY area_km DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: Find the names of districts whose government links use a 'gov' domain.
records.gold_sql: SELECT name FROM district WHERE Government_website LIKE "%gov%"

records.question: Return the ids and names of the districts whose population is larger than 4000 or area bigger than 3000.
records.gold_sql: SELECT district_id ,  name FROM district WHERE area_km  >  3000 OR population  >  4000

records.question: Find the average points and average ages of all spokesmen whose rank position is 1.
records.gold_sql: SELECT avg(points) ,  avg(age) FROM spokesman WHERE rank_position  =  1

records.question: What are the names and points of spokesmen who are younger than 40?
records.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  points FROM spokesman WHERE age  <  40

records.question: What is the name of the scuplture that was created most recently ?
records.gold_sql: select title from sculptures order by year desc limit 1

records.question: What are the names and dates created for all sculptures not located in gallery 226?
records.gold_sql: SELECT title ,  YEAR FROM sculptures WHERE LOCATION != "Gallery 226"

records.question: What are first names of the artists with oil paintings in gallery 241?
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT T1.fname FROM artists AS T1 JOIN paintings AS T2 ON T1.artistID  =  T2.painterID WHERE T2.medium  =  "oil" AND LOCATION  =  "Gallery 241"

records.question: How many paintings were created before 1900 in different locations?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  LOCATION FROM paintings WHERE YEAR  <  1900 GROUP BY LOCATION

records.question: Find the locations that have paintings before 1885 and no work with medium on canvas?
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT LOCATION FROM paintings WHERE YEAR  <  1885 AND mediumOn != "canvas"

records.question: show all years and the number of conferences in each year.
records.gold_sql: SELECT YEAR ,  count(*) FROM conference GROUP BY YEAR

records.question: What is the name of the institution with no staff in the records?
records.gold_sql: SELECT institution_name FROM institution WHERE institution_id NOT IN (SELECT institution_id FROM staff)

records.question: What is the maximum and minimum age of all staff from the United States?
records.gold_sql: SELECT max(age) ,  min(age) FROM staff

records.question: For each conference id, what are their names, year, and number of participants?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.conference_name ,  T1.year ,  count(*) FROM Conference AS T1 JOIN Conference_participation AS T2 ON T1.conference_id  =  T2.conference_id GROUP BY T2.conference_id

records.question: What are the names of the conferences that have the top 2 most people attending?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.conference_name FROM Conference AS T1 JOIN Conference_participation AS T2 ON T1.conference_id  =  T2.conference_id GROUP BY T2.conference_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 2

records.question: Show name, city, and state for all universities in  alphabetical order of university name.
records.gold_sql: SELECT university_name ,  city ,  state FROM University ORDER BY university_name

records.question: List team name for all universities with enrollments above the average.
records.gold_sql: SELECT team_name FROM University WHERE enrollment  >  (SELECT avg(enrollment) FROM University)

records.question: For every home conference, how many universities attended that conference?
records.gold_sql: SELECT home_conference ,  count(*) FROM University GROUP BY home_conference

records.question: List all major name and major code in the order of their major code
records.gold_sql: SELECT major_name ,  major_code FROM Major ORDER BY major_code

records.question: What is the name and citation point of the unversities with the top 3 reputation points?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.University_Name ,  T2.Citation_point FROM University AS T1 JOIN Overall_ranking AS T2 ON T1.university_id  =  T2.university_id ORDER BY T2.Reputation_point DESC LIMIT 3

records.question: Show minimum, maximum, and average annual fuel cost for all vehicles.
records.gold_sql: SELECT min(annual_fuel_cost) ,  max(annual_fuel_cost) ,  avg(annual_fuel_cost) FROM vehicles

records.question: Show the name and age of the customer with maximum membership credit.
records.gold_sql: SELECT name ,  age FROM customers ORDER BY membership_credit DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Show the name and total hours of renting for each vehicle.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name ,  sum(T1.total_hours) FROM renting_history AS T1 JOIN vehicles AS T2 ON T1.vehicles_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id

records.question: Show the vehicle name with a descending order of total hours of renting.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM renting_history AS T1 JOIN vehicles AS T2 ON T1.vehicles_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY sum(T1.total_hours) DESC

records.question: What is the discount name with most number of renting history records?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.name FROM renting_history AS T1 JOIN discount AS T2 ON T1.discount_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T2.id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: List all product names in descending order of price.
records.gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM Products ORDER BY product_price DESC

records.question: Show all hardware type products in ascending order of price.
records.gold_sql: SELECT product_name FROM Products WHERE product_type_code  =  "Hardware" ORDER BY product_price ASC

records.question: What is the code of the product type that is least common?
records.gold_sql: SELECT product_type_code FROM Products GROUP BY product_type_code ORDER BY count(*) ASC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many orders have each order status code?
records.gold_sql: SELECT order_status_code ,  count(*) FROM Customer_orders GROUP BY order_status_code

records.question: What are the ids of customers who have not made an order?
records.gold_sql: SELECT customer_id FROM Customers EXCEPT SELECT customer_id FROM Customer_orders

records.question: How many affiliations do we have?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM Affiliation

records.question: What is the title of the paper which cites the most other papers?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.title FROM Citation AS T1 JOIN Paper AS T2 ON T2.paper_id  =  T1.paper_id GROUP BY T1.paper_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: How many papers does Mckeown , Kathleen cite ?
records.gold_sql: select count(*) from citation as t1 join author_list as t2 on t1.paper_id  =  t2.paper_id join author as t3 on t2.author_id  =  t3.author_id where t3.name = "mckeown ,  kathleen"

records.question: How many papers does Stanford University have between 2000 and 2009?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT T1.paper_id) FROM Paper AS T1 JOIN Author_list AS T2 ON T1.paper_id  =  T2.paper_id JOIN Affiliation AS T3 ON T2.affiliation_id  =  T3.affiliation_id WHERE T1.year  >=  2000 AND T1.year  <=  2009 AND T3.name LIKE "Stanford University"

records.question: Give the title of the paper with the most authors.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.title FROM Author_list AS T1 JOIN Paper AS T2 ON T1.paper_id  =  T2.paper_id GROUP BY T2.paper_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: What is the average salary of all intern jobs?
records.gold_sql: SELECT avg(Salary) FROM Employee WHERE POSITION  =  "Intern";

records.question: List all Planets' names and coordinates in alphabetical order of name.
records.gold_sql: SELECT Name ,  Coordinates FROM Planet ORDER BY Name

records.question: List all shipment ids for the planet Mars and under the management of Turanga Leela.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.ShipmentID FROM Shipment AS T1 JOIN Planet AS T2 ON T1.Planet = T2.PlanetID JOIN Employee AS T3 ON T3.EmployeeID = T1.Manager WHERE T2.Name = "Mars" AND T3.Name = "Turanga Leela";

records.question: Which planet has total weight of shipment greater than 30? List planet name.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T3.Name FROM PACKAGE AS T1 JOIN Shipment AS T2 ON T1.Shipment = T2.ShipmentID JOIN Planet AS T3 ON T2.Planet = T3.PlanetID GROUP BY T2.Planet HAVING sum(T1.Weight)  >  30;

records.question: List package number of package shipped in planet Omicron Persei 8 and sent by Zapp Brannigan.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.PackageNumber FROM PACKAGE AS T1 JOIN Client AS T2 ON  T1.Sender = T2.AccountNumber JOIN Shipment AS T3 ON T1.Shipment = T3.ShipmentID JOIN Planet AS T4 ON T3.Planet = T4.PlanetID WHERE T2.Name = "Zapp Brannigan" AND T4.Name = "Omicron Persei 8";

records.question: Find the analytical layer type code that appears most often.
records.gold_sql: SELECT analytical_layer_type_code FROM analytical_layer GROUP BY analytical_layer_type_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Find the details of the customer who has used services the most times.
records.gold_sql: SELECT t1.customer_details FROM customers AS t1 JOIN customers_and_services AS t2 ON t1.customer_id  =  t2.customer_id GROUP BY t1.customer_details ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Find the name of the customer who has used the most types of services .
records.gold_sql: select t1.customer_details from customers as t1 join customers_and_services as t2 on t1.customer_id  =  t2.customer_id group by t1.customer_details order by count(*) desc limit 1

records.question: Which customers never used any services ? Give me the customer details .
records.gold_sql: select customer_details from customers where customer_id not in (select customer_id from customers_and_services)

records.question: Find the name of all the services which either have been used by customer "Hardy Kutch" or have been rated as "good" in one of the customer interactions.
records.gold_sql: SELECT DISTINCT t3.service_details FROM customers AS t1 JOIN customers_and_services AS t2 ON t1.customer_id  =  t2.customer_id JOIN services AS t3 ON t2.service_id  =  t3.service_id JOIN customer_interactions AS t4 ON t3.service_id  =  t4.service_id WHERE t1.customer_details  =  "Hardy Kutch" OR t4.services_and_channels_details  =  "good"

records.question: What are the names and dates of the exams with subject code that is not "Database"?
records.gold_sql: SELECT Exam_Date ,  Exam_Name FROM Exams WHERE Subject_Code != 'Database'

records.question: How many different comments are there for student answers?
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT Comments) FROM Student_Answers

records.question: Count the number of different comments for student answers.
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT Comments) FROM Student_Answers

records.question: Which students have 2 or more answer records? Give me their first names.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T2.First_Name FROM Student_Answers AS T1 JOIN Students AS T2 ON T1.Student_ID  =  T2.Student_ID GROUP BY T1.Student_ID HAVING COUNT(*)  >=  2

records.question: What is the most common valid answer text?
records.gold_sql: SELECT Valid_Answer_Text FROM Valid_Answers GROUP BY Valid_Answer_Text ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Show the ids and names for all documents by author Bianka Cummings.
records.gold_sql: SELECT document_id ,  document_name FROM Documents WHERE author_name  =  "Bianka Cummings"

records.question: What is the description for the process outcome code working?
records.gold_sql: SELECT process_outcome_description FROM Process_outcomes WHERE process_outcome_code  =  "working"

records.question: What is the description for process status code ct?
records.gold_sql: SELECT process_status_description FROM Process_status WHERE process_status_code  =  "ct"

records.question: List all process ids with no document.
records.gold_sql: SELECT process_id FROM Business_processes EXCEPT SELECT process_id FROM Documents_processes

records.question: Show all staff ids and the number of document processes for each staff.
records.gold_sql: SELECT staff_id ,  count(*) FROM Staff_in_processes GROUP BY staff_id

records.question: What are the biographical data and student id of the students who either took two or more classes and or have less than two detentions?
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.bio_data ,  T1.student_id FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Classes AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2 UNION SELECT T1.bio_data ,  T1.student_id FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Detention AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  <  2

records.question: Which teachers teach a class that has the substring 'data' in its detail but do not teach a class that has prefix 'net' in its detail? Give me the teacher details.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.teacher_details FROM Teachers AS T1 JOIN Classes AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id  =  T2.teacher_id WHERE T2.class_details LIKE '%data%' EXCEPT SELECT T1.teacher_details FROM Teachers AS T1 JOIN Classes AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id  =  T2.teacher_id WHERE T2.class_details LIKE 'net%'

records.question: Count the number of teachers who have taught students who have never won an achievement.
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(DISTINCT T1.teacher_id) FROM Teachers AS T1 JOIN Classes AS T2 ON T1.teacher_id  =  T2.teacher_id WHERE T2.student_id NOT IN ( SELECT student_id FROM Achievements )

records.question: How many courses do teachers teach at most? Also find the id of the teacher who teaches the most.
records.gold_sql: SELECT count(*) ,  teacher_id FROM Classes GROUP BY teacher_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

records.question: Among the students who have an event record, who do not have a student loan? Return the students' biographical data.
records.gold_sql: SELECT T1.bio_data FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Events AS T2 WHERE T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id EXCEPT SELECT T1.bio_data FROM Students AS T1 JOIN Student_Loans AS T2 WHERE T1.student_id  =  T2.student_id
